'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[music clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 610
|text = The clue reveals who to speak to:<br><br>I'd like to hear some music.
Come and see me on the bridge in
Falador Park, and play:
The Forlorn Homestead
Thanks,
Cecilia
|notes = Speak to [[Cecilia]] on the bridge in Falador Park. Play the [[music]] track [[The Forlorn Homestead]].
|map = {{Map|2990,3384|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Ring of wealth]] teleport to [[Falador Park]].
*[[Falador Teleport]] and run east into the park.
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Sir Rebral]].
*[[Balloon transport system]] to [[Taverley]].
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in [[Taverley]], or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the [[Taverley]] [[house portal]].
*[[Explorer's ring 2]] or higher teleport to the [[Farming patch]] at [[South Falador Farm]].
